items.title: Meta rolling out audio upgrades, turn-by-turn navigation for Ray-Ban smart glasses
items.excerpt: Meta rolling out audio upgrades, turn-by-turn navigation for Ray-Ban smart glasses — Meta’s most recent updates for its Ray-Ban smart glasses deliver upgrades to audio playback as well as new turn-by-turn walking...
items.rationale: A shipping software update that adds turn-by-turn walking navigation to AI glasses already on people's faces. It is the one Meta-glasses pick from the overlap group.

items.title: Windows 11 26H2 begins roll-out with AI File Explorer actions
items.excerpt: Microsoft rolls out Windows 11 version 26H2. Explore Copilot File Explorer AI tools, system settings, NLP controls, lightweight enablement packages, and IT security.
items.rationale: A major OS release now rolling out that puts Copilot actions into File Explorer, which changes everyday file work on Windows PCs right away.

items.title: tvOS 27.2 Code Hints at Apple Intelligence for New Apple TV
items.excerpt: tvOS 27.2 Code Hints at Apple Intelligence for New Apple TV — Apple's latest tvOS 27.2 beta adds weight to rumors that the next Apple TV will have Siri AI and Apple Intelligence support. Code suggests Apple is adding an Improve Siri & Apple Intelligence toggle to the tvOS Settings app.
items.rationale: New beta-code evidence that brings Siri AI to the living-room TV box. It is a different device and a different leak from the 10-05 iPad card.

items.title: The First 'Wireless GPU' Uses Wi-Fi to Headbutt All Those AI Subscriptions
items.excerpt: The First 'Wireless GPU' Uses Wi-Fi to Headbutt All Those AI Subscriptions — Just don't imagine the WiCi eGPU will be all that useful for turning your laptop into a gaming powerhouse.
items.rationale: A new hardware category, a Wi-Fi eGPU for running local AI, tested hands-on. It is a fresh take on local AI compute instead of another mini-PC.

items.title: Pixel Search could soon get a Gemini-powered upgrade along with privacy improvements
items.excerpt: Pixel Search could soon get a Gemini-powered upgrade along with privacy improvements — New Pixel Search update introduces a "Privacy & Permissions" section letting users stop the app from using their data to improve suggestions.
items.rationale: Gemini moving into the Pixel launcher's search bar, with a new control over whether your data trains suggestions. It covers a different surface from the published Pixel Buds and Call for Me cards and adds a fifth outlet.

dedup.note: SWAP (10-06): removed the TDK retinal-display pick (Notebookcheck) because the full-article check found the body never mentions AI; it is a pure optics story. Replaced it with Android Authority's Pixel Search Gemini teardown, the best remaining candidate where AI is central to the device. Its history_match (09-29 Pixel Buds Gemini controls) is a different product surface, and no published card covers Pixel launcher search, so it is new. The replacement also brings Notebookcheck down to one card and gives 5 distinct outlets. Other options passed over in this swap: Ghost Core (TechCrunch; mainly a funding story), Gemini Call for Me for contacts (an APK teardown expanding the 09-26 card), the EU Siri wait (a prediction), AMD Gorgon Halo benchmarks (vendor PR, covered 09-29), the UGREEN price drop (a deal), Deliveroo robots (AI not central), the Norway ban (politics), and any further Meta-glasses cards.
